context: Two friends remember a summer fireworks festival
purpose: Teach: 寿司/麺/花火/親切/暗い/天井/払う/終わら

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ねえ、去年の夏の花火大会、覚えてる？
lines.en: Hey, do you remember last summer's fireworks festival?
lines.style: Soft nostalgic opener, warm and dreamy tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: もちろん！屋台で食べたお寿司、めっちゃ美味しかったよね。
lines.en: Of course! The sushi we ate at the food stalls was so good.
lines.style: Bright energetic teenage excitement, casual upbeat delivery

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、それに麺類も食べたよね。焼きそばだったかな。
lines.en: Yeah, and we had noodles too. I think it was yakisoba.
lines.style: Gentle reminiscing voice, slightly trailing and thoughtful

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そうそう！あの時、道を教えてくれたおじさん、すごく親切な人だったね。
lines.en: Right, right! That old man who showed us the way was such a kind person.
lines.style: Lively recall, animated and friendly youthful tone

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 本当に。神社の中は暗いくらいで、提灯が天井から下がってて綺麗だった。
lines.en: Truly. It was so dark inside the shrine, but the lanterns hanging from the ceiling were beautiful.
lines.style: Soft wistful description, slow romantic cadence with quiet awe

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うちらお金を払うの忘れて、慌ててたじゃん！
lines.en: We forgot to pay the money and totally panicked, remember!
lines.style: Playful teasing laugh, fast cheerful teenage energy

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: やだ、思い出させないで〜。花火が終わらないうちに戻れて良かったよ。
lines.en: Stop, don't make me remember that! I'm glad we got back before the fireworks ended.
lines.style: Embarrassed soft laugh, sweet flustered romantic delivery

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今年も一緒に行こうよ、絶対！
lines.en: Let's definitely go together again this year!
lines.style: Enthusiastic teen invitation, bright hopeful upward inflection
